Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and next steps: 

- Current snapshot: Sofia (13), Marissa (12), Marcus (11). Close but not identical scoring scales — Marcus please check your total row (I can help).
- Decision rule (playbook): if top two are within 1 point, schedule a 20m technical micro-probe focusing on the tiebreak flags (caching + consistency). Owner: Marcus to run the probe (or pick a delegate).
- If the micro-probe still leaves a deadlock, we escalate to Hiring Committee with short written rationale (2 bullets each).

Action items:
1) Marcus: reconcile your totals in the sheet by EOD 4/15.
2) Marcus/Sofia: prep 3 micro-probe questions and pick a time 4/16 10-11am PT (tentative).
3) Marissa: if you prefer we skip the probe and move to committee, reply by 5pm today with your rationale.

I'll hold the calibration slot for now; cancel if we confirm no probe.
